title: GraphQL DataLoader Plan
description: A structured plan of DataLoader scoping, batch-contract handling, and query-abuse defenses for a GraphQL server, so this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/graphql_n_plus_one_dataloader_audit.mjs.

loaderScope.description: Where DataLoader instances are constructed: inside the per-request context factory, or once at module scope (the cross-request poisoning anti-pattern).

batchFnReordersByKey.description: True if every batchLoadFn reorders rows to match incoming key order (Map by id, then keys.map), since SQL IN (...) guarantees no row order and DataLoader matches by index.

batchFnReturnsKeyLengthArray.description: True if every batchLoadFn resolves an array exactly keys.length long, with null or an Error instance at missing indexes.

roundTripsForListQuery.description: Datastore round trips observed (or expected) for a list-of-N query with one nested association; batched is at most 2, regardless of N.

usedAsApplicationCache.description: True if DataLoader's cache is being relied on across requests as if it were Redis/Memcache.

depthLimitEnabled.description: True if a parse-time query depth limit is in the validation rules.

costAnalysisEnabled.description: True if cost analysis with list-argument multipliers (e.g. @cost, GraphQL Armor) enforces a maximum query cost.

introspectionExempt.description: True if __schema/__type introspection queries are exempted from the depth limit.

clientsExternal.description: True if external or mobile clients (bandwidth-sensitive, CDN-cacheable) consume this API.

apqEnabled.description: True if Automatic Persisted Queries (sha256-hash protocol) are enabled.
